text:
Recommended analysis: retain each model’s binary hit@10 for every validation user. Within each category, bootstrap 200 users with replacement, using identical resampled indices for both models; compute the paired HR difference. Repeat, e.g., 10,000 times with a separate fixed analysis RNG, reporting category differences and 95% intervals. Pairing preserves the covariance from shared users and candidates ([SciPy documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). Each replicate’s macro difference is the arithmetic mean of its four category differences; report its interval directly, rather than averaging interval endpoints. Keep categories fixed; cluster resampling by identity if users overlap across categories. One additional hit changes category HR by 0.005 and macro HR by 0.00125.

These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on fitted models, fixed candidate sets and the four datasets; they exclude training-seed variation and negative-candidate randomness. The fixed panel’s score itself is deterministic. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training/evaluation seed 42, candidate sets and evaluator. Interpret results as sampled-candidate HR@10: sampled metrics can reverse full-catalog model rankings, and tighter bootstrap intervals do not remove that bias ([Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Repeated validation selection creates optimism: the winning configuration exploits noise across trials and checkpoint choices. Ordinary bootstrap intervals around that winner do not correct adaptive selection ([Cawley and Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Log every validation query, predeclare stopping and comparison rules, report the search trajectory and all category outcomes, and label winner intervals exploratory. Multiplicity adjustment can support a prespecified comparison family but cannot erase unrestricted adaptive reuse. Keep hidden test data untouched; freeze the selected configuration before the host’s separate final evaluation.
